# The wheel set a release is expected to publish.
#
# One entry per wheel, holding everything after the `complexipy-<version>-`
# prefix. The verification step in the Release job compares the built set
# against this file before anything reaches PyPI.
#
# A missing entry fails the release, because a wheel that silently stopped
# being built is a regression users see. An extra entry only warns, because
# a new platform or interpreter is an addition rather than a loss.
#
# Derived from the 8.0.1 published set. `riscv64` is deliberately absent,
# because 8.0.1 predates that target, so its wheels are reported as extras
# until they are confirmed on a release and added here.
